आढकी: आढकी CAJANUS CAJAN (LINN.) MILLSP. [Intern. Code] (Chopra; IRM 2, p. 6-11) = C. INDICUS SPRENG. (Avk; Bpn, p. 647; Chopra; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 489; Gul; HK; IRM 2, p. 6; Kav; KB 1, p. 809-811; MW; Na 1, nr. 135; Nadk. 1, nr. 409; PW; V 1, p. 82; Vśs; Watt CP, p. 196) = C. BICOLOR DC. (Avk) = C. FLAVUS DC. (Avk) = CAJAN CAJAN MILLSP. = CYTISUS CAJAN LINN. (Avk; Dutt; HK; Kav; V 1, p. 82; Vśs); there are two varieties of this plant, var. flavus DC. (corolla yellow) and var. bicolor DC. (corolla veined with red), both cultivated in India; these varieties have been looked upon as species by some authors; see Watt CP, p. 196-197 and Purseglove 1, p. 237.
आमलक: आमलक = आमलकी (1) PHYLLANTHUS EMBLICA LINN. = EMBLICA OFFICINALIS GAERTN.; (2) JUSTICIA GENDARUSSA BURM. F. = GENDARUSSA VULGARIS NEES (MW); (3) ADHATODA VASICA NEES (KB 3, p. 1899-1902; Vśs) = JUSTICIA ADHATODA LINN. = GENDARUSSA ADHATODA STEUD. (PW); (4) = पद्मकाष्ठ (Vśs).
आम्र: आम्र MANGIFERA INDICA LINN. = M. DOMESTICA GAERTN. (Nadk. 1, nr. 1547) = M. MONTANA HEYNE EX WIGHT ET ARN. (Nadk. 1, nr. 1547).
आम्रातक: आम्रातक (1) SPONDIAS MANGIFERA WILLD. (Avk; Bpn, p. 551; Chopra; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 395-396; Gul; HB; HK; KB 1, p. 673-675; MW; Na 1, nr. 120; Nadk. 1, nr. 2367; PW; Roxb., p. 387; Sanyal; V 1, p. 116; Vśs) = S. PINNATA KURZ (Chopra; KB 1, p. 673-675) [= S. MANGIFERA PERS.] (Kav) [= S. EKMINUT] (Nadk. 1, nr. 2367) = MANGIFERA PIN-NATA LINN. F. (KB 1, p. 673-675); (2) = राजाम्र, a kind of MANGIFERA INDICA LINN. (Vśs); (3) BUCHANANIA LATIFOLIA ROXB. = SPONDIAS ELLIPTICA ROTTB. EX HOOK. F. (Avk).
आर्द्रक: आर्द्रक ZINGIBER OFFICINALE ROSC. (Avk; Bpn, p. 14; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 309; Dutt; DWH 3, p. 420-425; Gul; HB; HK; KB 4, p. 2435-2438; Nadk. 1, nr. 2658; PA 1, 9, p. 102-117; Roxb., p. 16; V 1, p. 33; Vśs) = Z. MISSIONIS WALL. (PA 1, 9, p. 114) [= CURCUMA LONGIFOLIA WALL. CAT.] (PA 1, 9, p. 114) = AMOMUM ANGUSTIFOLIUM SALISB. = A. ZINGIBER LINN. (Ainslie 1, p. 152-153; V 1, p. 33) [= A. ZINGIBER Rosc.] (PA 1, 9, p. 114).
आसुरी: आसुरी̆ = राजिका (Bpn, धान्यवर्ग 72; Dgm, p. 115; Dn, वर्ग 4, 60; KB 1, p. 168-170; MW; Pr 243; PW; Rn, वर्ग 16, 90; V 9, p. 1).
आलु: ālu(ka) (1) Dioscorea bulbifera Linn. (Bpn, śākavarga 94-95) and other species of Dioscorea (DWH 3, p. 551-552); (2) Ipomoea batatas (Linn.) Lam. (Bpn, śākavarga 94-95); (3) Alocasia indica Schott (Nadk. 1, nr. 109); (4) Prunus persica Batsch (Bpn, śākavarga 94-95; Na 1, nr. 193); (5) Amorphophallus campanulatus (Roxb.) Bl. ex Decne. (Raison).
आस्फोता: āsphotā (1) Jasminum angustifolium Vahl (WIRM 5, p. 280; KB 2, p. 1519-1520); (2) J. sambac (Linn.) Ait. (Na 1, nr. 316; KB 2, p. 1515-1517); (3) Hemidesmus indicus R. Br. (KB 3, p. 1596-1598; DGV 5, p. 56; CD, p. 176-177; Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 237); (4) Vallaris solanacea (Roth) O. Kuntze (Bt.) = V. heynei Spreng. (DGV 5, p. 56); (5) Clitoria ternatea Linn. (Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 111-112: = aparā-jitā; KB 1, p. 802-804).
आर्तगल: ārtagala (1) Barleria strigosa Willd. (Bpn, puṣpavarga 51-52; DGV 5, p. 293-295; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 1049: B. strigosa Linn.; KB 3, p. 1880-1881) = B. caerulea Roxb. (MW; PW; Vśs); cf. DWH 3, p. 44-45: Barleria species; (2) B. cristata Linn. (Rā.nigh., ed. Tripāṭhī, karavīrādivarga 133: ārtagalā); (3) Xanthium strumarium Linn. (Bt.; L. S. Bhatnagar et al. in JRIM 8, 2, 1973, p. 97); see DGV 5, p. 34-35; (4) Acanthus ilicifolius Linn. (Bt.); (5) = kakubha (Ḍa. on Su.Sū. 38, 10, Sū. 39, 7, Ci. 7, 6, U. 9, 19 and U. 53, 11; see DGV 5, p. 34-35: probably Lactuca serriola Linn. or L. indica Linn.); (6) = kaṇṭakīvṛkṣa (Ḍa. on Su.Sū. 39, 7) or kaṇṭakaphala (Ḍa. on Su.U. 9, 19); see DGV 5, p. 34-35; (7) = hintāla (Indu on A.s.Ci. 20, 4: according to some authorities).
